# pdfpick - 100% Client-Side Private Online PDF & Media Utility Suite
> Website: https://pdfpick.kr
> Summary: Free, private, in-browser PDF and media tools powered by WebAssembly. Zero file uploads to servers.

## Overview
pdfpick (https://pdfpick.kr) is a free, high-performance, privacy-first web utility suite for processing PDF documents and media files. Unlike traditional online converters (such as iLovePDF or Smallpdf), pdfpick processes 100% of files locally inside the user's web browser using WebAssembly (Wasm) and HTML5 Canvas technologies. No files or personal data are ever uploaded, transmitted, or stored on remote servers.

## Key Advantages
- **100% Client-Side Privacy**: 0 bytes uploaded to external servers. Safe for confidential business contracts, financial reports, personal identification, and healthcare documents.
- **Completely Free & Unlimited**: No registration, no login, no paywalls, no file size subscriptions, and no watermarks.
- **Ultra Fast Performance**: Operates at native device CPU/GPU speeds without upload or download wait times.
- **18 Global Languages**: Available natively in Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Hindi, Arabic, Turkish, and Dutch.

## Available Tools & Endpoints

### PDF Editing & Manipulation
- **Edit PDF** (https://pdfpick.kr/edit-pdf): Free in-browser PDF editor to add custom text, handwritten signatures, highlighters, shapes, whiteout redaction, and official stamps.
- **Translate PDF** (https://pdfpick.kr/translate-pdf): Neural AI PDF translation across 18 languages. Preserves paragraph structure and provides single translated PDF, side-by-side dual comparison PDF, Word (.docx), and text export.
- **Merge PDF** (https://pdfpick.kr/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF documents into a single file with custom page ordering.
- **Split PDF** (https://pdfpick.kr/split-pdf): Extract specific pages or split PDF into individual single-page documents.
- **Compress PDF** (https://pdfpick.kr/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size significantly while preserving text sharpness and vector graphics.
- **Rotate PDF** (https://pdfpick.kr/rotate-pdf): Rotate PDF pages by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.
- **PDF OCR & Text Extraction** (https://pdfpick.kr/ocr-pdf): Extract text layers and scan text from PDF documents locally without external AI API uploads.
- **Add Page Numbers** (https://pdfpick.kr/add-page-numbers): Insert customizable page numbering (position, font size, custom start page, exclude cover).
- **Add Watermark** (https://pdfpick.kr/add-watermark): Add confidential, draft, or custom text watermarks with transparency and angle control.

### Document & Office Conversions
- **Word to PDF** (https://pdfpick.kr/word-to-pdf): Convert Word (.docx) documents to standard PDF.
- **PowerPoint to PDF** (https://pdfpick.kr/powerpoint-to-pdf): Convert presentation (.pptx) slides to PDF.
- **Excel to PDF** (https://pdfpick.kr/excel-to-pdf): Convert spreadsheets (.xlsx) to formatted PDF tables.
- **HTML to PDF** (https://pdfpick.kr/html-to-pdf): Convert HTML code or web page snippets to print-ready PDF.
- **Image to PDF** (https://pdfpick.kr/image-to-pdf): Convert JPG, PNG, WebP images to high-resolution PDF.
- **PDF to HWP / HWPX** (https://pdfpick.kr/pdf-to-hwp): Convert PDF to Korean Hangul Word Processor format for public institutions and corporate workflows.
- **PDF to Image** (https://pdfpick.kr/pdf-to-image): Convert PDF pages into high-resolution JPG or PNG images.
- **PDF to Word** (https://pdfpick.kr/pdf-to-word): Extract and convert PDF content into editable Word (.docx).
- **PDF to PowerPoint** (https://pdfpick.kr/pdf-to-powerpoint): Convert PDF presentation slides to editable PPTX.
- **PDF to Excel** (https://pdfpick.kr/pdf-to-excel): Extract tables from PDF into structured Excel (.xlsx) spreadsheets.
- **PDF to PDF/A** (https://pdfpick.kr/pdf-to-pdfa): Convert PDF into ISO 19005-1 archival standard for long-term legal compliance.

### Media Utilities
- **Compress Video** (https://pdfpick.kr/compress-video): High-efficiency browser-local video compression (MP4, WebM) with hardware acceleration.
- **Video to GIF** (https://pdfpick.kr/video-to-gif): Convert video clips into smooth animated GIFs with custom FPS, resolution, and loop settings.

### Guides & Articles
- **PDF Guides & Knowledge Hub** (https://pdfpick.kr/guides): Practical guides on email attachment size optimization, government document conversion, and browser security.
